# type95

> Retro OS-skinned React component library: Windows 95, 98, XP, 7, 10 (WIP)

## Install

```bash
npm install type95
```

Peer requirement: your bundler must support CSS Modules natively (Next.js,
Vite, webpack all do). This package ships `.module.css` files unprocessed.

## Quick start

```tsx
import {Type95Provider, Button} from 'type95'

function App() {
  return (
    <Type95Provider skin="win98">
      <Button>OK</Button>
    </Type95Provider>
  )
}
```

Switch skins live (no re-render) with `setSkin('winxp')` from `type95`.

## Skins

- **win95** — done — flat title bar
- **win98** — done — gradient "web style" title bar
- **winxp** — done — Luna blue, rounded corners
- **win7** — placeholder tokens only — Aero glass not designed
- **win10** — placeholder tokens only — Fluent flat not designed

## Components

- **Button** — Classic raised 3D bevel button. Styling comes entirely from `--t95-*` (https://gregrickaby.github.io/type95/?path=/story/components-button--default)
- **Checkbox** — Sunken-box checkbox with a checkmark glyph, wrapped in a `<label>` so (https://gregrickaby.github.io/type95/?path=/story/components-checkbox--default)
- **Divider** — Horizontal groove line for separating sections of a dialog or menu. (https://gregrickaby.github.io/type95/?path=/story/components-divider--default)
- **MenuList** — A vertical list of selectable items (a dropdown menu, a Start-menu-style (https://gregrickaby.github.io/type95/?path=/story/components-menulist--default)
- **Panel** — Generic bordered container (GroupBox/"Cutout" style) with no opinion on (https://gregrickaby.github.io/type95/?path=/story/components-panel--default)
- **Radio** — Sunken-circle radio button with a dot glyph, wrapped in a `<label>` so (https://gregrickaby.github.io/type95/?path=/story/components-radio--default)
- **ScrollView** — A sunken, scrollable content box — the classic "cutout" preview pane (https://gregrickaby.github.io/type95/?path=/story/components-scrollview--default)
- **Tabs** — A tab strip and its associated panel — sourced from the identical (https://gregrickaby.github.io/type95/?path=/story/components-tabs--default)
- **TextInput** — Sunken-bevel single-line text field. Renders a native `<input>` (no (https://gregrickaby.github.io/type95/?path=/story/components-textinput--default)
- **TitleBar** — The title strip at the top of a `Window` — also usable standalone. (https://gregrickaby.github.io/type95/?path=/story/components-titlebar--default)
- **Window** — A framed window: a `TitleBar` on top and a body area below. Styling (https://gregrickaby.github.io/type95/?path=/story/components-window--default)

## Tokens

140 `--t95-*` custom properties drive every component's
styling (see `llms-full.txt` or `src/tokens/base.css` for the full list
with values). Never hardcode a color/border/font in a consuming
component — read a token instead so it keeps working across skins.
